metaDescription: Shop custom neon badges for high-visibility branding. Bulk orders available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Neon badges offer high visibility in low-light environments, making them ideal for safety managers coordinating night events or marketing directors seeking eye-catching name tags at concerts. The fluorescent colors — lime, pink, orange — ensure your logo stands out against any uniform or lanyard. Combine with bold imprinting for maximum impact.
heroAltText: Custom neon badges in bright lime, pink, and orange colors for high-visibility branding
